Horcrux: third-party licenses
=============================

Horcrux itself is free software under GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE).
It is built from 786 third-party Rust crates, listed below with their license and
followed by the license texts. Generated by ci/third-party-licenses.py from Cargo.lock; do
not edit by hand. The list covers every crate that can be compiled into a Horcrux binary on
any supported platform (normal and build dependencies, no test-only crates). Operating system
packages on a Horcrux install (Gentoo ebuilds) carry their own licenses, recorded by Portage
(`equery meta <package>`).

External programs Horcrux runs as separate processes (never linked, no code copied):
QEMU (GPL-2.0; the Horcrux Console reads guest screens through QEMU's D-Bus display
interface) and FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1+ or GPL-2.0+ depending on the distribution's build; the
Horcrux Console encoder runs `ffmpeg` as a child process). Both come from the OS packages.

System libraries loaded at run time when present (dlopen, no build-time headers, no code
copied, used unmodified from the OS packages): libx264 (GPL-2.0+; the console's in-process
H.264 encoder) and FFmpeg's libavcodec/libavutil (LGPL-2.1+ or GPL-2.0+; H.264 decoding in
the Horcrux Console desktop client).

Horcrux workspace crates (not listed below): horcrux-api, horcrux-auth, horcrux-backup, horcrux-cli, horcrux-cluster, horcrux-common, horcrux-container, horcrux-core, horcrux-desktop, horcrux-guest-proto, horcrux-guest-tools, horcrux-k8s, horcrux-media, horcrux-mobile, horcrux-monitoring, horcrux-nas, horcrux-sdn, horcrux-storage, horcrux-turn, horcrux-ui, horcrux-viewer, horcrux-vm, terraform-provider-horcrux
